acceptanceCriteria: An unadmitted receipt carries an opaque profile label or explicit not-admitted state that cannot be mistaken for a runner receipt; spec amended with requirement IDs; tests cover admitted vs opaque.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1328. assemble-stable (cem-stable-plain-assembly/1, no runnerAdmission) accepts any file as runner plan/receipt by SHA-256 only, and labels the emitted receipt record corvint-test-runner-receipt/0 with CALLER_OBSERVED, so an unadmitted file reads as a runner receipt.
title: assemble-stable labels an unadmitted opaque receipt as corvint-test-runner-receipt/0
